source.section: The Kill Chain: Assess; chapter6.1 context on PDF69/6-1
source.meaning: Assess returns to platform sensors to determine whether a target was hit and, if possible, what damage it suffered. Contact detection, location and tracking are separate from that assessment.
source.crosscheck: Chinese core_rules_cn:p075:c02; mandatory three-core-manual RAG searched for assessment/damage observation
source.repository_contract: agent.md: hidden information belongs to the referee/authority server; players and agents see only their side observation

projection.unverified_enemy_hit: withhold exact confirmed-hit count, accumulated DP, remaining HP fraction and shooter-side Impact/BaseDamaged copies
projection.victim: keep actual own-unit damage and own-side damage events
projection.referee: keep exact physical damage and the explicit disclosure-block trace
projection.sensor_label_or_class_identification: does not establish an exact remaining-HP estimator

limitations: This is a conservative v4 projection boundary, not a new BDA probability or HP-estimation formula.
A source-backed visual/acoustic/other damage-assessment path has not been implemented by this change.
Confirmed sinking, combat outcome acknowledgement, other legacy event producers and historical manually populated BDA records require separate audits.
Recorded Legacy, hv2026-rts-v2 and hv2026-rts-v3 semantics and their data fingerprints remain unchanged.
